coupling_convention: dimensionless g_an (assuming g_an = g_ap, from La < Lnu criterion)
notes: Carenza et al. (1906.11844) revise the SN1987A axion emissivity via NN bremsstrahlung beyond one-pion-exchange (finite pion mass, rho exchange, effective nucleon mass, multiple scattering). Main new limit: g_an = g_ap <= 6e-10 (free-streaming regime, La < Lnu at tpb=1 s), relaxed by factor ~3 vs naive OPE (2e-10). General coupling combination constrained: g_an^2 + 0.61 g_ap^2 + 0.53 g_an g_ap <= 8.26e-19, equivalent to m_a <= 5.67 meV * (C_an^2 + 0.61 C_ap^2 + 0.53 C_an C_ap)^{-1/2}; KSVZ: g_ap <= 1.2e-9, m_a <= 15 meV. The bound is mass-independent for light axions (no explicit validity range in mass given, hence mass-0 sentinel encoding). Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption. The confidence level is not a statistical CL (energy-loss argument), so the stated 0.95 is nominal.
